chunks: Whatsoever the blessings you enjoy are surely from God, and when in trouble you turn to Him in supplication.

key_terms.تَجْأَرُونَ: you cry out or supplicate earnestly

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the source of blessings and how humans respond to hardship?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the duality of human nature, contrasting the ingratitude often shown during prosperity with the immediate reliance on Allah during adversity. It serves as a reminder that while blessings are divine gifts, the act of supplication (du'a) in hardship reaffirms the monotheistic recognition of Allah as the sole source of relief and power.
